System: Ops-Core FAST SF Ballistic

Model: A14570-series

Configuration: OCC Dial

Description:

The ballistic composite shell provides excellent

lightweight protection from ballistic threats and

blunt trauma. This Ops-Core ballistic helmet is

usable in any environment including maritime

applications. Comes in Black, Tan, Ranger Green,

Urban Gray, or Multicam.

Modular Bungee Shroud retains the bungees

behind the shroud to cut down on snag hazards

and interfere with articulating goggles. Closed

loop.

Vented Lux Liner features a recessed channel

for airflow and clearance for over the head headsets.
